amendment2.authority: taskX2b-freshdata.md and live supervisor window-mean/capacity rulings before launch
amendment2.training: task.generate_batch(32, drivers+2, training_rng) fresh procedural per batch; seed0/1/2; archived train pool not used
amendment2.evaluation: X2 frozen validation and test pools unchanged, same seeds and hashes
amendment2.plateau: trailing train-loss improvement = (mean loss over the first 250 updates of the 2,000-step window minus mean loss over the final 250 updates) / first-window mean; plateau iff that ratio < 1% AND best-val gain < 0.001 (0.1pp) at step >= 10,000
amendment2.capacity: If free capacity <400GiB at a checkpoint check, retain best-val chain, every10K grid, latest250 rolling, own stop, legacy fixed {1000,4000,8000,12000,16000,18269}, and all known headline stop steps; scan published frozen selections each prune. Each prune records removed steps and retained hashes. Any cross-arm panel cell whose checkpoint was already pruned before its step became required is reported as unavailable/pruned - never imputed, never re-created by interpolation, never silently dropped. Stop steps broadcast via selection_frozen.json; running arms scan each250 check.
